title: AI需求2030年：翻数倍，下半年更高，谁在推动？
speaker: Mary Ann Sung

segments.en: If we look at structural trend, we have done quite a bit of analysis on dive through.
segments.zh: 从结构性趋势来看，我们做了大量深入分析。

segments.en: We look at older third party data, we look at global numbers.
segments.zh: 我们参考了第三方数据和全球数据。

segments.en: Structurally, we see significant strong growth demand from a demand side of the equation.
segments.zh: 从需求端来看，我们看到了显著强劲的增长需求。

segments.en: For the next few years, particularly going into 2030, we believe that the growth demand will likely to be multiple folds.
segments.zh: 未来几年，尤其是到2030年，我们相信需求增长可能会翻数倍。

segments.en: And hence, we are seeing the second half of this year, likely to deliver even higher growth versus first half.
segments.zh: 因此，我们预计今年下半年将比上半年实现更高的增长。

segments.en: And that's likely to continue for the next three years, a few years, mostly driven by a global demand of AI development, AI innovation, and more importantly is the AI deployment into scale.
segments.zh: 这种增长可能会持续未来几年，主要由全球AI发展和创新的需求驱动，更重要的是AI的大规模部署。
